title: Scholarship ROI Tracker
description: Build and manage a scholarship application pipeline of up to 12 awards. Estimates 2024-25 Federal Pell Grant eligibility, calculates net cost of attendance after all funding, and models loan impact (monthly payment, total interest, interest savings vs. baseline). Exports Policy Mandate and CSV pipeline report.
data_vintage: 2024-25 Federal Pell Grant schedule (Federal Register 2025-10243, max award $7,395, SAI cutoff $6,206) · Federal Direct Loan rate 6.53% (2024-25)

sai.description: Student Aid Index from FAFSA (negative values allowed; omit to skip Pell estimation)

annual_coa.description: Annual cost of attendance in USD

pell_estimate.description: Annual Pell Grant estimate in USD; null if SAI not provided

total_funding_secured.description: Sum of awarded scholarship amounts + Pell estimate (if applicable)

total_coa.description: Total cost of attendance over program years

net_coa.description: Remaining cost after all funding and personal contributions

coverage_pct.description: Percentage of total COA covered by scholarships + Pell

interest_savings_vs_baseline.description: Interest savings vs. borrowing full COA with no scholarships

mcp_tool_definition.name: track_scholarship_roi
mcp_tool_definition.description: Build a scholarship pipeline and calculate net cost of attendance. Estimates 2024-25 Federal Pell Grant eligibility from SAI, computes coverage ratio, and models loan cost reduction from awarded scholarships. Returns a scholarship_pipeline_plan Policy Mandate.

scholarships.description: Array of up to 12 scholarship records with name, type, annual_amount, status, deadline

sai.description: Student Aid Index from FAFSA for Pell Grant estimation (optional)

annual_coa.description: Annual cost of attendance in USD

loan_rate_pct.description: Federal Direct Loan interest rate as a percentage

regulatory_citations: Federal Register Vol. 90, No. 58 (2025-10243) — 2024-25 Pell Grant maximum award $7,395 and SAI schedule
Federal Student Aid — Federal Direct Unsubsidized Loan rate 6.53% (2024-25 award year)
